evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep: 'Can I have your name, please. Thank you Ruby.' Then: 'It's a house. Okay, and Ruby can I have your last name please.'
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep: 'So upon checking here we still have availability on the 3rd of November I just need to ask you questions specifically with regards to remove this would take about ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So you can walk away with a quote you can depend on instead of just the guest. Does that sounds good for you?'
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Rep: 'So we talked to a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns either the movers are not showing up on time or damage to their items, or either of those a concern for you.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about time-cost linkage and damage. Rep followed: 'Mm-hmm. Of course.' and then pressed on the rush hour angle. Customer clarified: 'if it's not affecting like the price. I don't mind if they're running behind.' Rep dug deeper into the damage concern separately.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep: 'As well. Oh. Oh, so from what I'm hearing, is that you're also concerned with regards to the damaging your items and for the movers if they won't show on, on time. Especially during rush hour. Did I get all of it?'
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep delivered On-Time Guarantee: 'if we're late, we start discounting your move immediately...we take fifty dollars off right away for the first hour than 25 dollars more every half hour after that.' And No Worries Damage Coverage: 'No wordy damaged coverage kicks in automatically that is up to 2000 dollars per...Move, and that's already included on the, are we that you're paying us no extra cost, no deductibles, no fine print'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Not asked. Rep delivered promises but did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep: 'Regarding your items do we have anything large or heavy, like safe piano larger workout equipments washers dryers TV.'
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep asked packing: 'Are we also moving boxes or not at all.' And box count: 'So for the boxes normally we just asked it for the boxes only because the truck can only fit in hundred boxes.'
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep: 'So basically based on your home size, normally we do a virtual walkthrough in that way we would just base it on the items that we're moving, do you have time to complete the virtual walkthrough today?' Customer agreed. Rep: 'I have already sent you the link on your mobile or on your contact number, have you received it by any chance?' Customer: 'Yes, I got it.' Rep: 'Perfect. So just upload the photos and the videos on the link so we can be able to review it. Once we have received it then we'll call you as soon as we can so we can provide you the estimate as well.'

top_strength: Excellent two-layer probing on customer concerns: the rep dug into both the time-cost linkage and damage fears separately, held silence, and reflected back what was heard with specificity before moving forward.
coaching_note: After delivering the Two Promises, ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or 'How do you feel about that?' to confirm the customer feels resolved before moving to probing—this closes the loop and signals transition.
